_comment: SAMPLE DATA — the WiSE strategy layer. Maintained by humans (leadership); Codex only updates seniorOkrs progress/history when a sourced signal appears, and never edits vision/pillars. Individual objectives in goals.json reference a pillar id to show how OKRs ladder up.
vision: Make WiSE the product every Sage customer discovers, understands and adopts without friction — with product marketing operating as one always-aligned team across every market.
narrative: FY26 Q4 is the WiSE launch quarter. Everything ladders to three things: land the launch, win the message, and know the market better than anyone. This hub is the single source of truth for how we're doing against that.

pillars.title: Land the launch
pillars.description: Ship the WiSE GA launch on time, with every market, channel and seller ready on day one.

pillars.title: Win the message
pillars.description: One messaging house, adopted everywhere — so every customer conversation sounds like Sage at its best.

pillars.title: Know the market
pillars.description: Always-on competitive and customer intelligence that shapes product, pricing and positioning decisions.

pillars.title: Operate as one
pillars.description: Priorities, progress and decisions visible in one place — zero status decks, zero surprises.
